[[File:GalacticGatheringHousePainting3D.jpg|170px|thumb|The painting viewed from a perspective which reveals the three-dimensional layering]]
'''''Galactic Gathering House Painting''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] traveling through the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] with [[Centerpoint Station]] and the [[Star/Legends|star]] of [[Corell/Legends|Corell]] in the background. The painting was layered in such a way as to appear three-dimensional.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Galactic Gathering House Painting'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
